anomalies: src-tracker-maps supersedes src-ink-maps for all map purposes. src-ink-maps remains on file (records are append-only) but its 9 whole-chapter PNGs are coarser, cover only A-sides, stop at Chapter 7, and carry no coordinates. Nothing referencing src-ink-maps has been emitted yet, so no sourceRefs need rewriting

src-tracker-maps: pins are named by room id ("Forsaken City A - Room 3b Strawberry"), while src-ink-collectables numbers berries sequentially per chapter ("Strawberry 4"). The two schemes must be cross-walked for all 175 strawberries before the mapPins and dataTable widgets can share item IDs — this is extract-data work and is the single largest open task on this guide

src-tracker-maps: 1216 pins is far more than the guide needs. Out of scope under the 32-achievement definition Pierre set on 2026-07-29 are the 801 roomsanity rooms, 82 binoculars, 24 keys/gems, the goldens, and the cars — all randomizer-specific. The widget pass must select the in-scope subset (175 strawberries, 8 cassettes, the crystal hearts, the level clears, the Moon Berry) rather than fill from the pin file wholesale

src-tracker-maps: Farewell's A-side heart pin is named "Crystal Heart?" in the pack, the only pin whose name carries an interrogative. Its identity must be confirmed against src-ink-chapters before it is emitted as a checkable

src-tracker-maps is licensed non-commercial by Zeeveez, and its map images are Celeste game assets used under EXOK Games's modding policy. TOTODILE is a personal non-commercial single-user app so the terms are met, but any redistribution question (including whether the 26 MB of map JPEGs are committed to a public GitHub repo) is Pierre's call and is not settled by this pass

Map images are not yet in the repo. guides/<slug>/images/ is tracked in git (266 images across the existing guides) while guides/<slug>/sources/ is gitignored, so the map JPEGs the mapPins widgets will reference have to be copied into guides/celeste/images/ and committed. Which subset, and at what resolution, is unresolved and blocks the mapPins widget fills

notes: Re-run appending one source, per Pierre 2026-07-29, after he supplied PopTracker packs at guides/celeste/sources/ as the intended mapPins data.

Two packs were supplied. Pierre chose the Zeeveez v2.0.2 pack (src-tracker-maps) and directed the other — Reisz's Celeste-OpenWorld-AP-Tracker-main — to be removed; that folder has been deleted from guides/celeste/sources/. Only the Zeeveez pack remains.

The Reisz pack was rejected because it ships no maps at all: its map images, pin coordinates and map tab layout are gitignored build outputs, so the copied folder contained only item lists, chapter icons (64x64 to 180x180, not maps), and a layouts/tracker.json referencing a "maps" layout that no file defines. Its data can be reproduced by running the upstream generator against the Berrycamp room dataset and Archipelago's CelesteLevelData.json — this was verified end to end in a scratch directory (112 maps, 97 MB of PNG, 252 pins, all in bounds) — but the Zeeveez pack ships equivalent data prebuilt, covers Farewell, and is a third the size, so no generator step is needed. Nothing from that exercise was written into the repo.

CORRECTION to the first run's anomaly "Berrycamp ... is dead": only the berrycamp.com website is gone (parked domain). The berrycamp/berrycamp.github.io repository is live and holds the room dataset plus 844 room captures. It is not recorded as a source because the Zeeveez pack makes it unnecessary.

Verified in src-tracker-maps: 175 red strawberry pins split 20/18/25/29/31/47/5 across Forsaken City, Old Site, Celestial Resort, Golden Ridge, Mirror Temple, The Summit and Core — an exact match with src-ink-collectables and with the "Impress Your Friends" achievement in src-ink-achievements. Three independent sources now agree on the completion target.

Farewell coverage is resolved: the pack carries 9 maps and 168 pins for chapter 10, including the Moon Berry. The first run's anomaly that Core and Farewell had no map is fully closed — Core has 9 maps and 87 pins.

deck.json updated per Pierre 2026-07-29: the mapPins slot moves from defaultScope "chapter" to "location" and is retitled "Checkpoint Map". The pack cuts maps chapter -> side -> sub-map (e.g. Forsaken City yields 1_a_0, 1_a_1, 1_a_2, 1_b_0, 1_b_1, 1_b_2, 1_c_0), 93 in all. A chapter-scoped map slot cannot express that; a location-scoped one can, with each sub-map becoming a spine location.

The first run's anomaly that no source gives per-berry map coordinates is resolved: every pin carries an exact x/y against a named map image, so pins no longer need to be derived from prose or flagged for uncertain placement.
